_what_this_is: THE PROGRAMME OF STUDY, IN FLIGHT. This file exists because the study's
PURPOSE kept being lost: the simulated runs were repeatedly described by
their success criterion (3 clean convergences) rather than by why they are
run at all. The founder had to point this out on 2026-10-03, and he was
substantially right -- arms 1 to 4 had each run twice, arm 5 had NEVER run,
and arm 5 is the only one that answers the effectiveness question.
A UserPromptSubmit hook reads this file EVERY TURN and injects a 1-line
reminder naming what is still outstanding. A compaction discards the
conversation; it does not discard this file. The reminder STOPS by itself
when every measurement carries a result and a headline -- `status` goes to
CLOSED -- so the mechanism expires rather than nagging forever.
rationale: To measure whether the fixes of the last 15+ days actually WORK. Clean convergence is the success CRITERION of the runs, NOT their purpose.
closes_when: every measurement below has result != null AND headline != null; then set status to CLOSED and the hook falls silent

measurements.what: Paired baseline: pre-window a2a0197 vs HEAD, same target, same seed. THE effectiveness question.
Declared state vs observed state: does what the launcher declares match what fires? The missing piece was the DATA, not the script -- no report recorded a declaration.

run_on_the_15_document_set.model_arm: 14 of 15 = 93.3333%, Wilson [70.1835%, 98.8133%]; sensitivity 10 of 10 = 100%; specificity 4 of 5 = 80%
run_on_the_15_document_set.syntax_arm: 10 of 15 = 66.6667%, Wilson [41.7135%, 84.8237%]; sensitivity 5 of 10 = 50%, indistinguishable from a coin

complementarity.answers_the_founders_question: YES, the arms are complementary: the syntax arm is right on 1 document Haiku gets wrong. An earlier report said the predictions were identical on all 15 -- what was identical was the OR COMPOSITION's predictions against Haiku alone, not the 2 arms.
complementarity.why_it_does_not_rescue_a_composition: The errors pull opposite ways. On mood_process Haiku says YES and is WRONG (a false positive) while syntax says NO and is right, so OR keeps the false positive (14 of 15, McNemar p = 1.000000) and AND fixes it but destroys all 5 prose positives (10 of 15, p = 0.218750). Neither is justified.

run_on_the_15_document_set.still_owed: the EXTENDED set. 15 documents cannot separate these effects: the complementarity rests on 1 document and the confidence label on a 5-versus-6 split. The builder emits a fixed 15, so extending it means authoring more documents with withheld labels.

The repointing experiment: 2 arms, A replays unedited to control for archive decay, B repoints at a different target. Settles over-specificity.
measurements.founder_ruling: RUN IT, record results, implement useful findings (2026-10-03)

population.why_unresolvable: sandbox-relative or ambiguous bare basenames -- a fact about where falsifiers run, not archive decay

result.why_neither: H_specificity needed p < 0.01 and got 0.1617, so the arms are not separable at this N. H_general needed arm B's rate INSIDE arm A's Wilson interval, and 87.5% sits 0.38 percentage points BELOW arm A's lower bound of 87.8812%.
result.precondition_correction: The first version required every named path to exist literally and reported 203 of 233 failing, 87.1245%, tripping its own degraded stop. Corrected BEFORE any arm ran: sandbox prefixes are stripped and bare basenames resolved only when unique across the tree excluding copies of it. Three successive measurements moved the usable population 43 -> 126 -> 46 -> 143; the 46 was an artefact of agent worktrees making one file look like four.

measurements.headline: 49 of 56 archived falsifiers still fire CONFIRMED when pointed at a file they were never written for -- the generality worry made concrete, though the pre-registered test cannot separate the arms at this N (Fisher p = 0.1617 against alpha 0.01).

measurements.what: The discrimination control reaches only falsifiers that come with a corrected copy. The shadow invariance probe synthesises the missing side; it runs as a POST-RUN SWEEP because inline would cost ~187 minutes per run. Measure its cannot-fail rate over each run, and its agreement with the real control where both can speak.
measurements.founder_ruling: EXTEND THE EXISTING GUARD, do not add a template (2026-10-03)

live_observations.what: C0002 ended round 1 with NO corrected copy after 3 separate supply attempts were refused, each for a different and correct reason: DeepSeek-SIM's own copy was not verbatim in the target, and ChatGPT-SIM's and Codex-SIM's were refused on OWNERSHIP -- the falsifier under control is DeepSeek-SIM's, and a copy correcting a different claim would mint a mechanical fault against a sound instrument.
live_observations.why_it_matters: This is the reach bound arriving live rather than as an archive statistic. The discrimination control cannot speak for C0002 at all, so it falls into the NO_CONTROL population that carried 0 stamps across the whole archive until 2026-10-03. The invariance sweep is the only instrument that will have anything to say about it.
live_observations.supply_route_that_DID_work: 4 of 5 findings carrying a fix and no copy had one DERIVED from the seat's own proposed fix, 1 declined -- so the derivation route is the one lifting reach, and ownership is what bounds the donation route.

The project's own committed oracles refuted it: `test_discrimination_control.py` states that withholding `verified` is what keeps a finding out of CLOSED, so the fix had armed discrimination_control_blocks by the back door -- the ruling the founder deferred.
